verdict_reason: The mapper's logic and null-handling are sound, but its one piece of custom behaviour (commodityComplement null-to-empty normalisation) has no direct or indirect test coverage anywhere in the repo.

todos.issue: New mapper introduces custom logic (copyCommodity/commodityComplements null-to-empty-list normalisation, the whole reason a default method exists instead of pure @DeepClone) but has no unit test anywhere; NotificationServiceTest's amend/cancelAmend coverage of deepClone() only exercises the Origin field, never Commodity/CommodityComplement, so the normalisation this file exists to provide is unverified.
todos.fix: Add a NotificationContentMapperTest (repo convention per NotificationCopyMapperTest/GbnAgMapperTest) asserting deepClone() normalises a null commodityComplement to an empty list, preserves a populated one via a distinct object graph, and round-trips the other content fields.
